answers.question: 深层网络的退化问题（degradation problem）在论文中如何描述？
answers.answer: 论文描述为：随着网络深度增加，准确率先饱和、随后快速下降；且这种退化不是由过拟合引起，给已经合适深度的模型继续叠加层数反而带来更高的训练误差。

citations.quote: When deeper networks are able to start converging, a degradation problem has been exposed: with the network depth increasing, accuracy gets saturated

answers.question: CIFAR-10 上 20 层与 56 层 plain 网络的训练误差对比如何？
answers.answer: Figure 1 的题注给出对比：在 CIFAR-10 上，层数更深的 56 层 plain 网络训练误差高于 20 层 plain 网络，因此测试误差也更高；图 4 表明 ImageNet 上存在类似现象。

citations.quote: Figure 1. Training error (left) and test error (right) on CIFAR-10 with 20-layer and 56-layer “plain” networks. The deeper network has higher training error, and thus test error.

answers.question: ImageNet 上 34 层与 18 层 plain 网络的验证误差关系？
answers.answer: Table 2 显示更深的 34 层 plain 网络验证误差高于更浅的 18 层 plain 网络，作者用 Fig. 4（左）比较两者训练/验证误差曲线以解释该现象。

citations.quote: The results in Table 2 show that the deeper 34-layer plain net has higher validation error than the shallower 18-layer plain net.
